Project Description
Hiredbuddy is seeking an entry-level Full Stack Developer to join our remote team. You'll build and maintain web applications, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and grow your skills in a supportive environment. If you're passionate about coding and ready to make an impact, apply today!
Full Description
As an Entry Level Full Stack Developer at Hiredbuddy, you will be an integral part of our engineering team, contributing to the design, development, and maintenance of web applications that serve a diverse client base. This remote role is perfect for someone who is eager to apply foundational coding skills in a real-world environment while learning from experienced professionals. You will work on both front-end and back-end components, ensuring seamless user experiences and robust server-side logic.
Key Responsibilities
Develop and maintain responsive web applications using modern JavaScript frameworks such as React or Vue.js for the front end.
Build and integrate RESTful APIs and microservices using Node.js, Express, or similar back-end technologies.
Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code that follows industry best practices.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams including designers, product managers, and other developers to deliver high-quality features.
Participate in code reviews, provide constructive feedback, and continuously improve development processes.
Troubleshoot and debug applications to optimize performance and ensure reliability.
Work with databases (SQL or NoSQL) to design schemas, write queries, and manage data storage.
Use version control systems like Git for collaborative development and deployment.
Stay updated with emerging technologies and suggest improvements to existing systems.
Assist in testing and deployment using CI/CD pipelines and cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, or Heroku).
Technologies and Tools
Our stack evolves, but currently we rely on:
Front-end: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES6+), React, Redux, or Vue.js
Back-end: Node.js, Express, Python (Django/Flask) or Ruby on Rails
Databases: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or MySQL
Version Control: Git, GitHub/GitLab
Deployment: Docker, AWS, Netlify, Vercel
Testing: Jest, Mocha, Chai, Cypress
Communication: Slack, Zoom, Jira, Trello
Growth and Development
At Hiredbuddy, we invest in our team's growth. You will receive direct mentorship from senior engineers, regular feedback, and access to resources that help you advance your skills. We encourage exploration of new tools and technologies, and we provide a clear path for progression to mid-level and senior roles. Your contributions will directly impact the success of our products and the satisfaction of our clients.
Work Environment
This is a fully remote position, allowing you to work from anywhere within the United States. We value work-life balance and flexibility, while maintaining a strong sense of community through virtual events, pair programming sessions, and open communication channels. You will have the support you need to succeed, whether it's through structured onboarding, regular check-ins, or a dedicated buddy system.
If you are ready to launch your career as a Full Stack Developer and make a meaningful impact, we would love to hear from you.
Requirements
0-2 years of experience in full stack development (internships and personal projects count)
Proficiency in at least one front-end framework (React, Vue, or Angular) and one back-end language (Node.js, Python, or Ruby)
Understanding of RESTful APIs and HTTP fundamentals
Familiarity with relational and/or NoSQL databases
Knowledge of version control systems (Git)
Ability to write clean, testable code
Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail
Excellent communication and teamwork abilities
Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote environment
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
Benefits
Competitive entry-level salary with performance reviews
100% remote work flexibility
Health, dental, and vision insurance
Paid time off and public holidays
Home office stipend
Access to learning platforms and certification courses
Mentorship from senior developers
Opportunity for career growth and role advancement

description_preview:
Introduction
At IBM Software, we transform client challenges into solutions. Building the world's leading AI-powered, cloud-native products that shape the future of business and society. Our legacy of innovation creates endless opportunities for IBMers to learn, grow, and make an impact on a global scale. Working in Software means joining a team fueled by curiosity and collaboration. You'll work with diverse technologies, partners, and industries to design, develop, and deliver solutions that power digital transformation. With a culture that values innovation, growth, and continuous learning, IBM Software places you at the heart of IBM's product and technology landscape. Here, you'l have the tools and opportunities to advance your career while creating software that changes the world.
Your Role And Responsibilities
Build AI for the systems the world relies on. At IBM Z, our technology supports the transactions and data behind banking, payments, and global commerce. We are bringing AI into that foundation to help developers build faster, simplify complex operations, and solve problems where reliability, security, and performance matter.
As an Entry Level AI Software Engineer, you will work alongside experienced engineers to turn advances in large language models into useful software. Depending on your team, you could build an agent that helps diagnose system issues, connect AI to enterprise data and tools, or create a simpler way for developers to work with complex systems. Bring your ideas, experiment, and help take a feature from prototype through testing and refinement.
What You’ll Do
Design, build, and test AI-powered features that address real developer and client needs, with guidance from experienced engineers.
Integrate LLMs, APIs, and enterprise data into applications, exploring agent workflows, tool calling, and retrieval where they fit the problem.
Write clear specifications and effective prompts, use AI development tools thoughtfully, and review and test the code they produce.
Evaluate AI behavior with realistic test cases, measure quality and performance, and improve how applications handle incorrect outputs and failures.
Debug across model interactions, application code, APIs, and underlying systems to understand root causes and build reliable solutions.
Collaborate through Git, code reviews, and technical discussions; document your work and iterate on feedback.
Location Flexibility: By applying to this requisition, you acknowledge and agree to be considered for any of the listed locations associated with this position and are willing to work at the location where you are ultimately assigned.
Preferred Education
Bachelor's Degree
Required Technical And Professional Expertise
Strong software engineering fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, software design, and testing.
Proficiency in Python and experience building applications or services that integrate APIs.
Hands-on experience building an application or working prototype with LLMs. You can explain what you built, how you integrated the model, and how you tested its behavior. Experience may come from personal, academic, open-source, or internship projects.
A systematic debugging mindset: you can investigate failures, test assumptions, and reason about how application code, data, models, and underlying systems interact.
Ability to translate a problem into clear requirements, prompts, and testable acceptance criteria, and critically evaluate AI-generated code and responses.
Familiarity with Git, clear technical communication, and the ability to learn quickly and collaborate on a team.
Preferred Technical And Professional Experience
Experience in one or more of the following areas is a plus. You do not need experience with every technology listed.
AI agents and tool or function calling; retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings, vector databases, or Model Context Protocol (MCP).
Independent AI projects, open-source contributions, or experiments beyond assigned coursework that demonstrate initiative and thoughtful engineering decisions.
Additional programming experience in JavaScript/TypeScript or Go, and familiarity with distributed systems or microservices.
Operating system concepts such as concurrency, multithreading, and memory management; relational databases and SQL.
Cloud and container technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, or OpenShift; observability, search, or real-time data processing tools such as OpenSearch or Kafka.
AI evaluation, anomaly detection, or experience measuring and improving model accuracy, latency, and reliability.
We are especially interested in what you have built and learned. Where available, include a project link, repository, demo, or a brief description of your contribution and the technical challenges you worked through.

description_preview:
Company Overview
Our company is a start-up that specializes in episodes of care benefit plans. We have a deep expertise in episode pricing and analytics and our goal is to bring transparency and efficiency to the healthcare market. Our company is committed to providing high-quality, affordable healthcare to our customers.
Role Description
The Data Integration Engineer for Healthcare Transactions is a hands-on software engineer responsible for designing, building, and operating the data pipelines and integrations that move healthcare data, including claims, enrollment, and other transactions, into and out of the organization's systems. This is an individual contributor role on the engineering team: this person writes the code, mappings, and tests behind each feed, deploys it to production, and owns its reliability from there. The ideal candidate is an engineer who knows healthcare data standards in detail and treats integrations as production software.
Responsibilities
Design, build, test, and deploy inbound and outbound data pipelines with providers, payers, vendors, and network partners, covering Claims and Billing files, Provider Directory files, NPPES, ICD10 and other data sources.
Write the parsing, mapping, and transformation logic in Python and SQL that validates, normalizes, and loads partner data into internal data models.
Build and maintain the APIs and services that move integrated data into billing and other core systems.
Build automated data quality checks, validation rules, and exception handling so bad or incomplete files are caught before they reach downstream systems or clients.
Instrument pipelines with logging, monitoring, and alerting; investigate production failures, perform root cause analysis, and ship fixes that keep issues from recurring.
Build reusable components and templates that make each new feed faster to stand up than the last.
Optimize pipelines for performance and cost as data volumes and the number of partners grow.
Apply HIPAA and security requirements in code and infrastructure, including encryption, secure file transfer, access controls, and audit logging.
Own the technical side of new client and partner connections end to end: review file specifications, build and test the feed, run test cycles with the partner, and move to production.
Work directly with technical contacts at clients and vendors to troubleshoot data issues and agree on file layouts and requirements (e.g., custom 837 claims, 834 enrollment files).
Work with Product, account management, and operations teams to turn business requirements into technical designs with clear acceptance criteria.
Surface integration pain points and edge cases to inform the product and engineering roadmap.
Follow the team's software development practices, including version control, code review, automated testing, and CI/CD deployments.
Write and maintain technical specifications, mapping documents, and runbooks so integrations can be supported and extended by other engineers.
Qualifications
Describe the experience and attributes of the ideal candidate
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Healthcare Informatics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
3+ years of hands-on software or data engineering experience building and supporting production data integrations, preferably within the healthcare sector (payer or health plan experience a plus).
Strong proficiency in Python and SQL.
Working knowledge of healthcare transaction standards, especially X12 837 and 834; experience with 835, 270/271, HL7, or FHIR a plus.
Experience building data pipelines on AWS (e.g., S3, Lambda).
Experience with RESTful APIs, JSON, and SFTP-based file exchange.

About Mainspring
Mainspring Energy manufactures and delivers fuel-flexible, low-emissions local power solutions that rapidly add new capacity and deliver reliable, affordable, and sustainable electric power. The company began commercial shipments of its Mainspring Linear Generators in 2020 and today has hundreds of megawatts in advanced development and field operations for leading Fortune 500 companies, data centers, and utilities. Mainspring also partners with global energy leaders including AEP, NextEra Energy Resources, Schneider Electric, and more.
The

Pragmatic Optimism

Overview
Do you enjoy controlling multi-domain physical systems like robots, cars, or generators using embedded systems? Are you passionate about modeling system dynamics (linear or nonlinear), designing control algorithms, implementing them in hardware, and verifying real-world performance?
We have a high-impact opportunity for a Controls Engineer to join a world-class engineering team, designing and implementing new automation and control algorithms for our Linear Generator - a sophisticated, automated system with mechanical, electrical, fluid, thermodynamic, and thermal dynamics. Controls are central to its performance and behavior.
The Electrical Systems Control team specializes in coordinating the control of inverters, batteries, brake resistors, and generators on a common DC bus to provide consistent and reliable power. In this role, you will learn the fundamentals of each of these components to enable smooth and reliable power production. You will be paired closely with senior engineering mentors dedicated to accelerating your technical mastery, systems thinking, and long-term career growth.
We're looking for a driven, self-directed problem solver who thinks in systems, learns fast, takes coaching well, and is a team player. You have a strong interest in software, sensors, real-time control, and automation for dynamic systems, and you're excited about Mainspring's mission to deliver clean, affordable, and resilient power.
Responsibilities
As an Associate Controls Engineer in the Electrical Systems Controls team, you will:
Help integrate inverters, batteries, brake resistors, and generators all on a common DC bus.
Design, implement, and tune control algorithms that coordinate the DC bus, batteries, and grid tie inverters, in simulation and on hardware.
Implement algorithms and continuous-integration tests (MIL, SIL, PIL) in C++17.
Develop automation, diagnostics, and fail-safes for a novel integrated platform.
Analyze system data and refine control strategies.
Develop and automate test plans, test cases, and traceability matrices to ensure comprehensive coverage.
Conduct failure analysis, risk mitigation, and validation to maintain robust control performance.
Debug sensors, actuators, and subsystems, addressing noise, disturbances, and calibration.
Support fleet generator operation, manufacturing testing, and reliability efforts.
Collaborate cross-functionally with power electronics, mechanical, thermal, firmware, and test teams to define requirements, integrate multi-physics systems, implement new software features, and drive validation.
Receive regular 1-on-1 mentorship, structured code reviews, and hands-on guidance from senior staff to accelerate your technical and domain expertise.
Start by building simulation tests and supporting hardware validation of new grid tie inverter control algorithms, with a structured pathway toward taking full technical ownership of critical control subsystems.
Qualifications
BS or MS in electrical, mechanical, or software engineering with a specialization in control systems or power systems
0–2 years of relevant work experience
Experience designing, implementing, and testing controls and automation algorithms in software.
A growth mindset with a strong desire to learn from experienced mentors and work across multi-disciplinary engineering domains.
Strong communication skills and an enthusiasm for active collaboration across diverse hardware and software engineering teams.

title: Software Engineer
reason: Stack +32; Title fit +12; US +10
description_preview:
About Us
Mintive helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. That has to start from trust. Our first product is an MCP gateway that gives those agents governed access to company data and tools.
Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. Our gateway product scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on.
We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how.
We are AI-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them.
Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co-founded Coursera.
The Job
You will own features end to end, from conception to production, across our gateway infrastructure, enterprise deployments, and agentic systems. The work leans backend and infra, but nothing is off limits: when the product needs a better UI you build it, and when a connector breaks during a security review you fix it.
Claude and Codex are your primary working environment, and you use a fleet of agents to move faster than a team this size has any right to. Agents write much of the code and review PRs, so your real job is the judgment they cannot make: shaping the problem, making architecture, product, and UX calls, hardening enterprise paths, designing connectors, protecting security-sensitive surfaces, and catching generated code that is quietly wrong. Roles are blurred and we ship within hours, and you will learn directly from the founders and from customers.
We hire across levels, from strong early-career builders to seasoned engineers, and we set level and pay to match. What matters most is judgment, range, and how fast you ship.
About You
You are a builder with a track record of shipping to real users, whether that is a product, an internal tool, an open-source project, or a serious side project. You ship, then iterate, without waiting for specs or approvals.
You have strong fundamentals and learn fast. How quickly you pick things up matters as much as years of experience.
You care about product value and customer needs over technical purity.
You take infra seriously. You think about blast radius, trust boundaries, and what happens when your code is in the path of every customer's agents.
You can read unfamiliar code, reason from first principles, and explain your tradeoffs.
You are comfortable across the stack (TypeScript, Python, CockroachDB), or you pick up new languages, protocols, and domains fast.
You are excited to build with agents, and to learn when they help and when they hide a problem.
You already build with AI every day and want room to move without heavy process.
Nice to have:
Developer-facing products, protocol or gateway work, or infrastructure at scale.
Background in security, identity, or permission systems.
Contributions to open source, MCP servers, or agentic frameworks.
Design sensibility: engineers who care about design, designers who think about infrastructure.
What we offer:
Competitive compensation and meaningful equity.
Unusual scope and ownership of features that ship to enterprise customers.
Building and deploying agents on the same platform we sell.
Direct access to the founders, customer context, and product direction, with mentorship as you grow.
Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first.
Prefer to have your agent apply? Point it at
https://www.mintmcp.com/hiring/mcp

Founding Embedded Software Engineer - Build the flight software behind a new class of interceptor systems
Hawthorne, California | On-site
Opportunity Summary
Join a recently funded seed-stage defense technology startup developing a new generation of low-cost interceptor systems for rapidly evolving airborne threats. The company has already built and demonstrated working flight hardware with military users and is now expanding its core engineering team as it moves from early intercept demonstrations toward deployable systems and higher-rate production. As an Embedded Software Engineer, you will own a significant portion of the software running directly on the vehicle. You will develop real-time flight software, integrate sensors and hardware, translate GNC algorithms into reliable embedded implementations, and help evolve the existing software stack into a production-ready system. We are a seed-stage defense technology company developing compact, highly maneuverable interceptor systems designed around lower cost, rapid iteration, and scalable manufacturing. Own and advance embedded software across guidance, navigation, flight control, sensing, and vehicle systems
Develop production-quality C/C++ for bare-metal, RTOS, and other resource-constrained embedded environments
Translate GNC algorithms and mathematical models into reliable real-time flight software
Optimize software for deterministic execution, low latency, memory efficiency, and limited onboard compute
Integrate IMUs, GNSS, magnetometers, RF systems, optical sensors, and other vehicle sensors into the flight-software architecture

Work closely with GNC, electrical, mechanical, propulsion, and test engineers to define interfaces and system requirements
Help establish the embedded software architecture, development standards, and technical practices that future engineers will build upon

Experience developing software for microcontrollers, embedded processors, or other resource-constrained compute platforms

About The Company
NuAxis Innovations is a federal IT company on a mission to make customer experience the center of every government solution. We believe technology is at its best when it serves the people who use it. Our team brings together engineers, creative thinkers, and problem-solvers who care about helping federal clients succeed. We value collaboration, mutual support, and a people-first approach to work. At NuAxis, teamwork is more than a principle; it is part of how we work every day. We believe supported, engaged employees can do their best work and create better outcomes for the communities and customers our clients serve.
About The Role
The Web Developer II designs, develops, maintains, and enhances front-end and back-end web applications. You will help support Internet, Intranet, Wiki, and social media platforms, with a focus on usability, accessibility, performance, and security. The role includes developing and maintaining Drupal-based solutions, managing content and functionality, and collaborating with application developers to integrate web applications and services. You will contribute to site improvements throughout the development lifecycle, from planning and implementation through testing and ongoing maintenance. This position is suited to a detail-oriented developer who can manage multiple priorities and apply federal web requirements and industry best practices to practical solutions.
Qualifications
An associate’s degree in Web Development, Computer Science, or a related field is preferred. An equivalent combination of education and professional experience will also be considered. Acquia Drupal certifications are encouraged but are not required. Candidates should have at least three years of professional experience in web design and development, including hands-on experience building and maintaining applications with Drupal, HTML5, CSS2/3, JavaScript, PHP, Python, and jQuery. Familiarity with Drupal implementation, migration, and integration is important.
Working knowledge of Node.js, Git, Chrome Developer Tools, Jenkins or other CI/CD tools, and SEO and web marketing practices is expected. Exposure to backend frameworks, application integration, and federal web standards is beneficial. Strong attention to detail, effective written and verbal communication, and the ability to collaborate while managing competing priorities are essential. Candidates should be committed to accessible, usable web experiences and motivated to stay current with evolving technologies and development practices.
Responsibilities
Design, develop, test, implement, and maintain secure, scalable, and high-performing front-end and back-end applications. Plan and manage content and functionality across Internet, Intranet, Wiki, and social media platforms. Implement, migrate, integrate, and support content management systems, with a strong emphasis on Drupal, and deliver content updates and ongoing site enhancements.
Apply usability principles to site architecture, navigation, knowledge management, and information delivery. Collaborate with application developers to connect web applications and services. Use tools such as Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, and GIMP to support visual and user interface needs. Test and validate applications for compliance with WCAG, Section 508 of the Rehabilitation Act, and the Americans with Disabilities Act. Apply internet security principles and protocols, and ensure copyrighted materials are used appropriately under U.S. copyright law.
Benefits
NuAxis offers a collaborative, supportive workplace where people and teamwork matter. Employees have the opportunity to contribute to meaningful federal technology work, develop their skills, and work alongside colleagues with varied technical and creative perspectives. Learn more about NuAxis benefits and culture during the application process. Employment is contingent upon successfully completing a background investigation.
Equal Opportunity
NuAxis Innovations is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome applicants who are interested in contributing their skills and perspectives to our people-centered mission. If this opportunity aligns with your experience and interests, join our talent community and apply.

description_preview:
Please note that this position is based on our campus in Madison, WI, and requires relocation to the area. We recruit nationally and provide financial relocation assistance.
Code that saves lives.
As a software developer at Epic, you’ll write software that impacts the lives of 325 million patients around the world. Working in your own office, surrounded by thousands of high-caliber developers, you’ll use modern development methodologies and employ user-centered design, analytics, and machine learning tools to drive innovation in healthcare. Using leading-edge technologies and languages like JS, TS, and C#, you’ll invent better ways to reduce medical errors, streamline record sharing between hospitals, and provide the quality of care a patient deserves. Learn more about our team at https://careers.epic.com/jobs/softwaredevelopment/.
Write software for the most innovative health systems on the planet.
The top-ranked health systems in U.S. News and World Report are Epic customers. Our community includes major systems like the Mayo Clinic, Johns Hopkins, Cleveland Clinic, and Kaiser Permanente, as well as leading academic medical centers at the University of Wisconsin, University of Michigan, University of California, University of Texas, The Ohio State University, and many more.
Live affordably in a city known for its rising tech talent.
Epic is located just outside Madison, Wisconsin, the second fastest growing market for tech talent in the United States and home to the state capital and the University of Wisconsin. Madison, a city surrounded by water, has received accolades for being the greenest city in America (NerdWallet), the best city for renters (SmartAsset), the fittest city in America (Fitbit), and the third best metro in the US for young professionals (Forbes Advisor).
More than just important work
.
Our uniquely themed campus was designed to heighten your ability to get stuff done in your office, a conference room, or by the fireplace in a comfy chair. All meals are restaurant-quality but cost only a few dollars, and they’re prepared by a team comprised of kitchen talent from restaurants around the country. And, after five years here, you’ll earn a four-week sabbatical anywhere in the world. Staff have kayaked in Patagonia, attended a Beyoncé concert in Ireland, built a library in Tanzania, and run a marathon in Antarctica.
We offer comprehensive benefits to keep you healthy and happy as you grow in your life and career, and your merit-based compensation will reflect the impact your work has on the company and our customers. You'll also be eligible for annual raises and bonuses, as well as stock grants, which give you an even greater stake in the success of Epic and our customers. Healthcare is global, and building the best ideas from around the world into Epic software is a point of pride. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we know that inclusive teams design software that supports the delivery of quality care for all patients, so diversity, equity, and inclusion are written into our principles. Please see our full non-discrimination statement at https://careers.epic.com/EEO.
Relocation to the Madison, WI area (Reimbursed)
BS/BA or greater in Computer Science, Mathematics, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field
A history of academic excellence or professional success
Eligible to work in the United States without visa sponsorship (persons with appropriate qualifications and eligible for TN status under NAFTA may apply)
COVID-19 vaccination

Job Details
Job Description:
As a Compiler Engineer, you will be at the forefront of advancing Intel's industry-leading compiler technologies. In this role, you will design, develop, optimize, and maintain cutting-edge compiler tools that unlock the full potential of Intel's processor platforms, targeting CPUs, GPUs, and accelerators. Your contributions will directly enable developers and organizations worldwide to achieve breakthroughs in AI, high-performance computing, and other transformative technologies.
Business group
The Compiler Engineering team within Intel's Data Center Group (DCG) is dedicated to creating robust software tools that empower the development of innovative and high-performing applications. The team plays an essential role in supporting Intel's broader mission to deliver scalable solutions that shape the future of computing. As part of this dynamic group, you will collaborate with global experts driving progress in compiler technology and programming languages.
Key Responsibilities
Develop new compiler features and optimizations tailored to Intel architectures, enhancing performance and functionality.
Collaborate with hardware engineering teams to support new processor features and improve compiler integration with evolving architectures.
Contribute to the development and maintenance of compiler frameworks such as LLVM, Clang, SYCL, and Fortran.
Conduct functional and performance experiments, debugging, and defect resolution to improve compiler reliability and output quality.
Participate in upstream collaboration with open-source communities to drive industry-wide compiler advancements.
Investigate opportunities for code parallelization, vectorization techniques, and performance enhancements in Intel compilers.
Analyze application and benchmark performance to identify and implement improvements.
Work closely with cross-geo engineering and validation teams to ensure quality and performance standards are met.
Behavioral Traits
Demonstrated success in debugging, problem-solving, and proactively seeking solutions.
Work independently and contribute effectively to open-source projects.
Qualifications
This is an entry level position. You must possess the below minimum qualifications to be initially considered for this position. Preferred qualifications are in addition to the minimum qualifications and are considered a plus factor in identifying top candidates.
This position is not eligible for Intel immigration sponsorship.
Requirements listed would be obtained through a combination of industry relevant job experience, internship experiences and or schoolwork/classes/research.
Minimum Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Electronic Engineering, Informatics, or a closely related technical discipline.
2+ years of experience with:
C/C++, SYCL, CUDA, DSLs programming, object-oriented design principles, and complex data structures.
Compiler technologies and LLVM compiler infrastructure.
Preferred Qualifications
2+ years of experience developing and maintaining production-grade compilers.
Familiarity with LLVM framework components, including IR generation, passes, and backend development.
Experience with vectorization techniques, parallel programming models like OpenMP and SYCL, and GPU compiler optimizations.
Strong understanding of processor architectures, performance analysis, and memory optimizations.
Demonstrated experience collaborating with language standards groups or contributing to standards development.
Knowledge of MLIR and TileIR representation and compiler infrastructure for DSL programming languages in AI domains

description_preview:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.
We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.
Here’s what this particular role covers.
🛠️ About Our Engineering Teams
Our Fleet Management team builds the platform that connects Wayve’s engineers and operators with a global fleet of autonomous vehicles and data-collection devices. From software deployment and vehicle health to robotaxi operations, our services give teams the visibility and control they need to operate confidently as the fleet grows.
You’ll join an early-stage team working across web applications, backend services, embedded APIs and cloud infrastructure. With multiple OEM integrations and vehicle configurations to support, you’ll help shape both the systems we build and the engineering practices behind them.
🧠 Your day-to-day
Own full-stack features, working with senior engineers, Product Managers and Designers to turn agreed designs into production-quality software.
Contribute to technical discussions and break work into practical implementation steps.
Follow your work through testing, deployment and maintenance.
Write clean, performant code, debug issues and review peers’ changes.
Share what you learn and take on more complex problems as your experience grows.
Keep usability and reliability central to the tools you build for real vehicle operations.
🧩 What You’ll Be Working On
Frontend and backend features that help teams understand fleet health, configuration, software status and location.
APIs, databases and cloud services behind Fleet Management workflows.
Tools that support engineers and operators across different OEMs and vehicle configurations.
Scalable, maintainable services developed in partnership with senior engineers.
Automated tests, debugging and code reviews that improve the quality and consistency of the platform.
🙌 You should apply if
You have professional experience building full-stack web applications or services, with genuine hands-on exposure to both frontend and backend development.
You have worked with APIs, schemas, databases and backend services.
You can deliver clean, tested and maintainable code, and contribute thoughtfully to technical design discussions.
You are familiar with cloud services, distributed systems or microservice architectures.
You take ownership of assigned work, communicate proactively and enjoy learning from experienced teammates.
Experience with React, TypeScript, MUI, Rust, Go, Node.js, Kubernetes, Bazel or Azure would be useful, but not required.
Bonus if you have experience with fleet management, robotics, autonomy, operational tooling, monitoring or high-volume data workflows.
🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.
More About Wayve
🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.
Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.
How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working:
Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.
🔍 The Interview Process
Our process is clear and respectful of your time:
Initial call / recruiter screen (30 mins).
Competency Interviews: Programing and Domain Knowledge (3 hours ).
Deep-dive technical interviews: System Design and Hiring Manager Interview (1,5 hour in total).
Final interview: Mission & Values alignment (30 mins).
We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.
What’s in it for you (Location dependant):
💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually
📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve
✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable
✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs
📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth
🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more
A quick, honest note before you apply.
Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written.

Associate Level (0-2 years experience /New Grads)
Mid Level (3-5 years experience)
Senior Level (5-15 years experience)
SDET (3+ years experience)
Work at the cutting edge of enterprise AI, solving complex challenges and improving how intelligent systems perform at scale. In this role, you’ll troubleshoot AI behavior, partner with other engineers to fix root causes, and continuously enhance platform performance across LLMs, agent workflows, and backend systems.
This isn’t traditional support—you’ll play a hands-on role in shaping how AI is built, used, and experienced across the organization.
Video Interview Process:
As part of our Software Engineer hiring efforts, we're using a video screening process and coding assessment. To learn more and to help prepare for this click here!
Section 2: Job Functions, Essential Duties and Responsibilities
Technical Support & Triage
Investigate and resolve issues reported by users of Agent Assist
Reproduce issues and trace failures across:
LLM responses and prompts
Agent workflows and orchestration
Tool/MCP calls and backend integrations (e.g., Salesforce and internal enterprise applications)
Analyze logs, traces, and telemetry (e.g., Langfuse, NewRelic logs)
Clearly document findings and partner with engineering on resolution leveraging Azure DevOps
AI System Debugging & Improvement
Identify whether issues stem from prompting, retrieval (RAG), tool selection, or backend systems
Propose improvements to agents, skills, prompts, and workflows
Use AI-powered tools (e.g., Cursor) to accelerate debugging, analysis, and solutioning
Contribute to continuous improvement of system reliability and response quality
User Enablement & Evangelism
Train internal users on how to effectively use Agent Assist
Run targeted demos, onboarding sessions, and office hours
Act as a trusted advisor to client-facing associates
Drive adoption by helping users understand both capabilities and limitations
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Partner closely with engineering, product, and AI teams
Translate user issues into clear, actionable tickets and improvements
Identify recurring patterns and escalate systemic issues
General
Responsible for protecting, securing, and proper handling of all confidential data held by Ascensus to ensure against unauthorized access, improper transmission, and/or unapproved disclosure of information that could result in harm to Ascensus or our clients.
At Ascensus we are guided by our Core Values of People Matter, Quality First and Integrity Always®. They inspire us every day to prioritize an environment of respect for those we serve and one another and should be visible in your actions on a day-to-day.
Section 3: Experience, Skills, Knowledge Requirements
Up to 3 years’ experience in a Software Engineering, Software Support, QA, SDET, or engineering-adjacent role (including internships, co-ops, or academic projects)
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Information Systems, Business Information Systems, or a related technical field
Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot and debug technical issues, focusing on root cause analysis
Foundational experience or exposure to:
API testing (Postman or similar)
Reading logs and debugging application behavior
Basic SQL or data inspection
Exposure to or strong interest in AI/LLM-based systems (prompting, chatbots, RAG, or agents) through coursework, projects, or hands-on experimentation
Experience using or willingness to learn AI-powered development tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code)
Strong communication skills with the ability to translate technical issues into clear explanations for non-technical users
Demonstrated curiosity and ability to learn quickly in a fast-evolving technical environment
Qualified candidates must complete a video interview assessment after applying as the next step, to be completed within 7 days of receiving the link. How to prepare: Set aside 40-45 minutes for the self-guided assessment that includes games and questions. Find a quiet place to record and be camera-ready. You’ll need a smartphone, tablet, or desktop computer with your camera and microphone enabled. You’ll answer questions to share your skills and experience and bring your personality to the interview. This step accelerates the interview process, moving qualified candidates to hiring manager interview fast

Familiarity with the following is preferred:
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
Tool/agent orchestration
Prompt engineering

description_preview:
Who we are
About Stripe
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.
About The Team
Before Stripe, every growing internet platform needed a payments team. Today, every growing internet platform needs a way to establish trust in its users.
Identity verification is a core piece of economic infrastructure for online businesses. Stripe Identity enables businesses to digitally verify their users through identity documents and other signals for fraud prevention, regulatory, and trust and safety use cases. We are building the future of identity verification and trust in the digital economy.
The Identity Product Experience team owns Stripe Identity’s mobile SDKs for iOS, Android, and React Native. These SDKs enable businesses to embed secure, high-quality identity-verification experiences directly in their mobile applications. Our work spans mobile user experience, reusable SDK architecture, camera and document-capture experiences, developer experience, security, accessibility, reliability, and integration with Stripe’s backend systems.
Why Stripe Identity?
Build mobile experiences that help establish trust between businesses and their users.
Solve challenging product and technical problems involving mobile platforms, sensitive data, fraud prevention, and global scale.
Create SDKs used by developers across industries, including fintech, marketplaces, and online platforms.
Help shape the future of digital identity and make verification easier, safer, and more accessible.
Our vision is to build the world’s most trusted store of verified identities, enabling frictionless identity verification across Stripe and beyond.
We’re looking for engineers who care deeply about mobile craft and the entire user journey. You should enjoy translating complex technical and regulatory requirements into simple, polished experiences; working through ambiguity; and learning new technologies and systems.
Join us to build mobile identity-verification experiences that businesses can integrate easily and that their users can trust.
What you’ll do
Responsibilities
As an iOS engineer on the Identity team, you will:
Design, build, and maintain Stripe Identity’s mobile SDKs and verification experiences across iOS, Android, and React Native.
Create intuitive, polished experiences for complex flows such as identity-document and selfie capture, while accounting for accessibility, device capabilities, and varied real-world conditions.
Build reliable and extensible SDK APIs and reusable components that make it easy for developers to integrate Stripe Identity into their applications.
Work across mobile clients, supporting APIs, and services to deliver features end to end rather than treating the mobile application as an isolated layer.
Improve SDK performance, reliability, observability, testing, release processes, and backward compatibility.
Make thoughtful architectural decisions that balance user experience, developer experience, security, privacy, and long-term maintainability.
Partner closely with product managers, designers, machine-learning engineers, backend engineers, user researchers, and other mobile teams.
Work with Stripe users and field teams to understand integration challenges and turn their feedback into product and platform improvements.
Help establish and evolve mobile-engineering practices across Identity and Stripe.
Operate and maintain the systems and SDKs the team owns, including diagnosing production issues and improving them based on what we learn.
Who you are
We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.
Minimum Requirements
3+ years of professional software-development experience, including meaningful experience building and shipping mobile applications or SDKs.
Experience developing for at least one major mobile platform using technologies such as Swift or Objective-C for iOS
Strong software-design fundamentals and experience creating maintainable APIs, components, or frameworks.
Experience delivering mobile functionality beyond an isolated UI layer for example, integrating with APIs and services, handling local state, or working with device capabilities.
Experience testing, debugging, monitoring, and improving mobile software in production.
Ability to collaborate effectively with engineering, product, design, and other technical and non-technical partners.
A demonstrated commitment to building high-quality user and developer experiences.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience building mobile SDKs, shared libraries, or developer-facing APIs used outside your immediate team.
Experience with both iOS and Android, or with cross-platform technologies such as React Native or Kotlin Multiplatform.
Experience with camera, image-processing, document-capture, biometrics, or other device-integrated mobile experiences.
Experience designing mobile software that handles sensitive data and applies security and privacy principles by default.
Familiarity with accessibility, internationalization, mobile performance, and unreliable network conditions.
Experience with mobile CI, automated testing, release automation, observability, or developer-productivity tooling.
Experience contributing to backend APIs or services that support mobile products.
Ability to simplify complex requirements and favor durable, scalable solutions.
Comfort reasoning clearly and moving with urgency in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment.

title: Embedded Software Engineer - Broadband CPE
reason: Stack +32; Title fit +12; Exp fit +10; US +10; Overqualified -45
description_preview:
At T-Mobile, we invest in YOU! Our Total Rewards Package ensures that employees get the same big love we give our customers. All team members receive a competitive base salary and compensation package - this is Total Rewards. Employees enjoy multiple wealth-building opportunities through our annual stock grant, employee stock purchase plan, 401(k), and access to free, year-round money coaches. That’s how we’re UNSTOPPABLE for our employees!
Job Overview
T-Mobile Home Internet is one of our fastest growing businesses, and the software this team builds runs on every gateway and mesh extender we put in a customer's home. We're a small development team on a large program, so you'll contribute to meaningful software development work from the start.
You'll develop the device agents that manage, monitor, and troubleshoot our broadband customer premises equipment. They're written in C and C++ against the Broadband Forum's open USP standards and run on the RDK-B platform. The agent uses a microservice architecture, and you'll develop and maintain assigned services within the established architecture.
Your agents will interface with the device's Wi-Fi and cellular subsystems through RDK and RBUS. You won't be writing Wi-Fi drivers or modem firmware, but understanding those technologies, and how RDK components talk to each other, is central to doing this job well.
What You'll Do
Develop and maintain one or more microservices within the device management agent, in C and C++ on RDK-B.
Implement and maintain device data model parameters and USP protocol behavior across supported hardware platforms.
Interface with the device's Wi-Fi and cellular subsystems through RDK and RBUS to configure them, query state, and report it upstream.
Build and maintain the containerized services that run on the device, delivered through a Kubernetes-based packaging and deployment pipeline.
Write unit tests for new and changed code and extend our automated test coverage.
Debug across the device software stack, from log analysis and root cause investigation through to fix verification.
Support device maintenance releases, including test support, firmware validation, and release verification.
Work with OEM partners on defect triage and reproduction.
Improve how we collect data and logs from the field so issues can be triaged and resolved faster.
Contribute ideas that improve how we build, test, and deliver device software.
Document your code, the data model and device behavior.
Job Summary
This role is essential for designing, implementing, and deploying scalable software solutions that meet customer requirements and support high availability environments. The role involves collaborating with engineering teams to develop software components using technologies such as virtualization, microservices, software-defined networking, network functions virtualization, and broadband device management. This position requires independent development of software components and understanding system protocols, data flows, and technology interactions, including those supporting broadband customer premises equipment (CPE). Success is measured by the ability to deliver technical solutions, produce clear documentation, and contribute to technology strategy and innovation. The work impacts the organization by enabling advanced software systems that improve operational efficiency and support business goals.
Main Responsibilities
Develop software solutions that support engineering projects and meet customer requirements, including developing and maintaining embedded software components and device management services for broadband CPE.
Collaborate with technical teams to deliver effective technical solutions and continuously learn new technologies, including supporting software debugging, testing, release verification, and defect investigation with OEM partners.
Create clear documentation for software code, system designs, and business requirements, including device data models and software behavior.
Contribute to technology strategy by understanding current technologies and supporting business goals, including improvements to device software testing, diagnostics, and development processes.
Present innovative ideas to improve systems, processes, or services based on industry research, including improvements to device software reliability and troubleshooting.
Also responsible for other duties/projects as assigned by business management as needed.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's Degree plus 3 years of related work experience OR advanced degree with 1 year of related work experience OR combination of education and experience deemed equivalent.
Acceptable areas of study include Computer Science or Engineering.
2-4 years of technical engineering experience.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with RDK-B and RBUS, or a comparable embedded networking platform and message bus.
C and C++ development on embedded Linux.
Strong Wi-Fi knowledge: 802.11 standards and generations, band and channel behavior, client association and steering, and practical troubleshooting.
Strong grounding in the IP stack and network technologies: TCP/IP, DHCP, DNS, NAT, routing and bridging.
Working understanding of 5G networks and fixed wireless access.
Familiarity with TR-069, TR-369 (USP), or TR-181 device management standards.
Experience writing unit tests and building or extending automated test coverage.
Experience with containerized applications and delivering packages to embedded devices.
Proficiency with Git and continuous integration pipelines.
Hands-on development experience with cellular, Wi-Fi, mesh networking, or other carrier-side telecom products.
Proficiency in C and C++.
Working knowledge of networking fundamentals and comfort debugging software you did not write.
Required Knowledge, Skills And Abilities
Analytical Thinking
Collaboration
Continuous Development
DevOps
Emerging Technologies
Programming Languages
Software Design
Software Development

title: Engineering Graduate Programme (New York)
reason: Stack +8; US +10
description_preview:
Programme start date: September 2027
Please review all the graduate programme opportunities and make one application
Are you passionate about engineering and technology?
Do you want to make a difference by delivering software used by some of the biggest companies in the world?
Do you thrive in dynamic, agile environments and enjoy collaborating with others?
During your time with us you will have the opportunity to explore potential career paths by working within our Engineering function based in
New York.
To be eligible you must be a final year undergraduate or Masters student in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Engineering, Information Technology or related discipline and have completed all the requirements of your course before August 2027 or a fresh graduate in class of 2026.
Highlights of the Graduate Programme
Progress through a 12-month development journey aiming to build foundational skills that are key for your future success
Build your foundational knowledge of LSEG, Financial Markets and the business during your global induction
'Engineering Bootcamp' week to immerse you in the business and Engineering principles
Participate in group projects which are aligned to LSEG goals
Meet in person with your cohort at ‘Ignite’, the programme mid-point skills offsite. Explore key knowledge areas and skills
Access opportunities to earn industry-recognized qualifications, including 5 study days during programme
Connect with global early careers community and opportunities and contribute to wider society via CSR initiatives and volunteering opportunities
Our graduates join us on a permanent basis, and from day one you will be aligned to an Engineering Team, which will allow you to develop within a secure framework.
Roles in the Engineering apply deep technical and analytical expertise to build, operate and improve the platforms, products, services and models that power our business. Spanning software and platform, reliability, quality, cyber security, service operations, service management, financial engineering and data science, these roles work across the full lifecycle to solve complex problems, enable secure and resilient delivery, and drive continuous improvement in a product-led, data-driven environment.
Software & Platform Engineering
Roles in Software & Platform Engineering focus on building and improving the software, infrastructure and systems that support our products and services. Engineers work across the full software and infrastructure lifecycle to deliver usable, maintainable applications.
Reliability Engineering
Roles in the Reliability Engineering track play a crucial role in identifying and reducing risks to performance and availability. They develop tools and implement strategies to prevent problems before they occur and recover quickly from a failure keeping platforms, applications, and services stable and reliable.
During the recruitment process we will get to know your skills and interest and how they align with the needs of the business to place you in your Engineering Team.
What We Are Looking For
We are passionate about recruiting people who have a genuine curiosity about Technology and strive to pursue a Technology career path, as evidenced by their studies, extracurriculars or work experience. It’s important to us that you can also understand the breadth of our organisation, how it functions and the vital role that technology plays in supporting LSEG and our clients.
You will have a strong interest in technology proven either via your work experience, extracurricular activities, or academic studies. For instance, you may have secured an internship in a technology role or focused on technology as part of a university project. You may have learnt how to code or how to use a particular technology.
You should have a demonstrable interest in financial markets, which you’ve built through your studies, work experience or extracurricular activities.
A curiosity for data and an ability to analyse information to draw conclusions and propose solutions.
Individuals who can connect the dots and think strategically.
The environment we work in is fast paced, you’ll need to demonstrate focus, resilience and the flexibility to adapt to changing demands.
People who can collaborate with others, using their communication skills in the process.
Ideal candidates will have the rights to work in the US without restrictions for the duration of the graduate programme and joins us on a permanent basis from day one.
We value not just what you achieve, but how you achieve it.
We are considering candidates beyond the core software degrees (e.g. computer science, software engineering, Mathematics and Informatics) and candidate with physics, engineering, electronic degree who can demonstrate an interest in Technology as evidenced by extracurriculars or work experience, or personal projects can apply.
Application close:
20th October
, however we recommend an early application because we consider candidates on a rolling basis. Due to the volume of applications, we might close the applications earlier, so we recommend an early application.
Recruitment Process:
The first stage of the recruitment process involves making an application and submitting your resume.
The second stage is completing Technical and Coding Assessment.
The third stage of the application process is an Immersive Online Assessment. The assessment is designed to give you an insight into what it’s like to work at LSEG.
The fourth stage is a video interview where you will answer a series of questions using a strength-based-interview style.
The final stage is a half day assessment centre which involves several different types of exercises – further information is provided at the point of invite.
Please review all the graduate programme opportunities and make one application If you make more than one application, we will review your first application only.
Please note, all our assessment centres are held virtually.
Life at LSEG

As the company and its products evolve, we welcome individuals who are curious, adaptable, and committed to learning.
About The Role
Logoslabs is seeking a Software Engineer to help design, develop, test, and maintain software applications. In this role, you will collaborate with engineers, product partners, designers, and other stakeholders to turn requirements into dependable, user-focused solutions. You will contribute across the software development lifecycle, from early technical discussions and implementation through testing, release, and ongoing improvement.
The ideal candidate brings a strong foundation in software engineering, a practical approach to solving problems, and a willingness to work collaboratively. You should be comfortable balancing independent tasks with shared team priorities, communicating progress and challenges, and adapting as product requirements change. This position offers the opportunity to contribute to technical decisions and help strengthen development practices as Logoslabs grows.
Qualifications
Applicants should have professional experience in software development or equivalent practical experience building and maintaining software. A solid understanding of programming fundamentals, data structures, algorithms, and common software design principles is expected. Experience with one or more modern programming languages and familiarity with web applications, APIs, databases, or cloud-based services will be valuable.
Qualified candidates can write clear, maintainable code and understand the importance of testing, documentation, and code review. You should be able to investigate technical issues, evaluate possible solutions, and explain your reasoning to colleagues with different levels of technical expertise. Familiarity with version control, automated testing, continuous integration, and agile or iterative development practices is an advantage.
A degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related field may be helpful, but equivalent experience and demonstrated skills are also welcome. We value a growth mindset, attention to detail, sound judgment, and respect for different perspectives. Candidates should be organized, dependable, and motivated to learn new tools and technologies as the needs of the team evolve.
Responsibilities
Design, implement, and maintain software features in line with product requirements, technical standards, and user needs. Work with teammates to clarify scope, identify dependencies, estimate effort, and break larger projects into manageable tasks. Develop code that is readable, secure, efficient, and designed for long-term support.
Write and maintain unit, integration, and other appropriate tests. Participate in code reviews, provide constructive feedback, and incorporate feedback from colleagues. Troubleshoot defects and production issues, identify root causes, and contribute to fixes and preventive improvements. Keep technical documentation and implementation details up to date.
Collaborate with product and design partners to assess trade-offs and deliver practical solutions. Communicate progress, risks, and blockers early, and contribute to planning and retrospectives. Look for opportunities to improve system reliability, development workflows, and the overall quality of the user experience.
Benefits
Logoslabs offers a collaborative environment where employees can develop their skills, take on meaningful technical challenges, and contribute to product improvements. Depending on role location and employment arrangement, eligible employees may have access to competitive compensation, paid time off, health and wellness programs, professional development resources, and flexible work arrangements. Specific benefits, eligibility, and terms will be discussed during the hiring process.
Equal Opportunity
Logoslabs is an equal opportunity employer. We consider applicants without regard to protected characteristics under applicable law and are committed to a respectful, inclusive hiring process. We welcome candidates with different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. Reasonable accommodations are available for applicants who need them during the application or interview process.

description_preview:
Job Description
The Contract for Organizing Spaceflight Mission Operations and Systems (COSMOS), NASA’s next-generation mission operations contract, has an excellent opportunity for a Mid-Level Systems Engineer to join the Performance Engineering team. System Performance Engineering encompasses the techniques applied during the system development life cycle to ensure the non-functional requirements for ground systems within the Mission Control Center Systems (MCCS), Training Systems (TS), Space Vehicle Mockup Facility (SVMF) are met. Adherence to the non-functional requirements is also validated post-deployment by monitoring the production systems. The applicant will work in a dynamic team environment and will be responsible for working with the NASA customer, other systems engineers, and software engineers to understand system requirements and to determine the operation of the system through measuring and evaluating its system performance characteristics. The applicant will have the unique opportunity to support human spaceflight during the mission operation critical phases of launch, rendezvous, and landing. COSMOS ensures the continuity of critical human spaceflight support by providing mission control services, advanced training systems, and full-scale spacecraft mockups for astronaut preparation and engineering analysis.
Description Of Duties
The Performance Engineer is responsible for working in a dynamic team environment and will be responsible for working with the NASA customer, other systems engineers, users, and software engineers to determine the operation of the system through measuring and evaluating its system performance characteristics. The applicant will ensure that the team is working closely with COSMOS Platform/OS and Software Engineers, System Testers, and Project Managers to ensure system performance and stability across COSMOS facilitate primarily the MCC and Training systems. The expectation is for the potential candidate to participate in mission systems failure and anomaly investigations, support real-time mission activities, and customer daily operations meetings. The candidate will also pursue integration assignments within the Integration Services department to help achieve department, directorate, and contract goals. The candidate should have a good understanding of the full software development life cycle from planning, design, building, testing, deployment and maintenance.
Successful candidates will:
Be curious and willing to learn
Collect raw resource utilization data from workstations, servers and networks from the development, integration and production environments
Process resource utilization data; manage, protect and retain the raw resource utilization data
Provide resource metrics for platforms and networking devices
Provide impact assessments and cost associated with critical designs
Investigate system anomalies using current/historical system data and user reports
Maintain technical performance measures
Perform and support system testing and benchmarking
Establish baselines of current system behavior tailored for specific investigations

Define infrastructure as code and ship through GitHub Actions pipelines with automated testing, environment promotion, and secure release practices.

At KBR, we deliver science, technology and engineering solutions to governments and companies around the world. KBR is proud to work with its customers across the globe to provide technology, value-added services, and long-term operations and maintenance services to ensure consistent delivery with predictable results.
Trinzic is the future independent company to be created through the planned spin-off of KBR's Mission Technology Solutions business, expected in January 2027. Candidates who join KBR's Mission Technology Solutions business before the spin-off will transition to Trinzic when the separation is complete and will not need to reapply for employment.
Job Summary
KBR is seeking an NS4R Software Developer to join our team in Colorado Springs, CO or El Segundo, CA.
This job supports SSC within the Joint Terminal Engineering Office (JTEO) as a developer on the National Security SATCOM Systems Synchronization Roadmap (NS4R) software application. The NS4R application is hosted on Defense Information Systems Agency’s (DISA) MilCloud and requires close coordination with DISA to resolve issues in a timely manner. In support of JTEO, duties include maintaining the NS4R database including security upgrades, development and implementation of enhancements to the NS4R tool, providing user held desk support, maintaining user accounts, providing NS4R database backups, maintaining configuration control and backups of the source code, support JTEO to evaluate and address security requirements and perform troubleshooting. The job requires the ability to assist Level 1 POCs with data entries and identify and correct incomplete or questionable data entries and management of the NS4R MilCloud Virtual Data Center (Memory/Storage/CPUs etc.). This also includes development and installation of patches to the Operating System and Data Base Server. As needed, you can expect to train Government and FFRDC personnel on the use and maintenance of the NS4R tool and database.
The MILSATCOM Systems Engineering, Integration, and Test (MSEIT) effort provides leading edge Systems Engineering & Integration (SE&I) for the Air Force’s Space and Missiles System Center. We support the Air Force’s acquisition of state-of-the-art Military Satellite Communications systems, providing global secure, survivable, and protected communications for our nation’s warfighters. We seek technical individuals who will thrive in a highly collaborative work environment of small teams, using the most modern tools and methodologies to tackle the challenges of integrating complex space and ground communications systems.
